table.name: TLGNC_SHIPTO_SAREA
table.description: The Sales Areas available for a shipto. From SAP, a soldto-shipto relation is always related to a sales area, and Logon is no different. Similar, tables typically refer to shipto-sarea instead of shipto directly.

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SAREA. The Sales Area, which consists of Sales Organisation + Distribution Channel + Division.

column.name: FREE_DELIVERY_FLAG
column.description: Controls whether free of charge delivery are POSSIBLE for orders based on this shipto. This is typically done for customers (defined per shipto-sarea) who frequently order big amounts, or for sample deliveries etc. If 1: In tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr and during the order creation it is allowed to select no billto = free of charge delivery.

column.name: RELEASE_SAP_OPTIONAL_FLAG
column.description: Controls whether 'Release to SAP' is automatic (0) or optional (1). If automatic: tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.hold_back_sap_flag is not editable, and always false. These two flags also effect order creation and editing of existing orders.

column.name: APPLY_SD_LEADTIME_CHK_FROM_MI
column.description: [min after midnight] Apply the same-day lead-time check for web orders with delivery to time larger than or equal to this value (of the same day). Earlier delivery to times are not possible. Must be larger than ALLOW_SD_WEB_ORDER_UNTIl_MI. This value is overrides TLGNC_SAREA.APPLY_SD_LEADTIME_CHK_FROM_MI.

column.name: APPLY_ND_LEADTIME_CHK_UNTIL_MI
column.description: [min after midnight] Apply the next-day lead-time check only for web orders with delivery to time smaller than this value (of the next day). This value is overrides TLGNC_SAREA.APPLY_ND_LEADTIME_CHK_UNTIL_MI.

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_DEST_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_distribution_dest_bs, where selectable_for_shipto_flag=1. Distribution Destination type (outbound, interunit prod., interunit distribution) used for orders to this shipto (see tlgnc_order.distribution_dest_cd, in combination with normal/return-order logic for rail orders).

column.name: DBLT_ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=inactive,1=active. Is distance based lead time check for delivery_from_dat active for customers.

column.name: SDLT_AND_NDLT_ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=inactive,1=active. Is current day and next day lead time check active for delivery_to_dat for customers.

column.name: DBLT_DISTANCE_L1
column.description: Lower distance limit for distance based lead time check for delivery_from_dat.

column.name: DBLT_DISTANCE_L2
column.description: Upper distance limit for distance based lead time check for delivery_from_dat.

column.name: H1_EARLY_ORDER_LIMIT
column.description: Defines 'if ordered before' rule for distance based lead time check for delivery_from_dat.

column.name: H2_EARLIEST_DELIVERY_FROM
column.description: Earliest possible delivery from time for delivery_from_dat for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D1
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D2
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D3
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D4
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D5
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.

column.name: DBLT_OFFSET_D6
column.description: Offset value for distance based lead time check.
